title: Ella Fitzgerald joins Tiny Bradshaw after the Harlem Opera House contest
summary: After winning the amateur contest Ella sang with Bradshaw's band, then went back to Chick Webb without a contract.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: We stayed there two years, until they got too big for himself and wanted to try to buck the booking agent -- that was wrong. See, what happened, when Ella Fitzgerald, after she won the amateur contest at the Apollo, we were going -- we had left Chicago, came on through Chicago, through Ohio, through Pennsylvania, back to New York. And we went into the Harlem -- the Opera House, which is boarded up now, on 126th Street and 7th Avenue. And that's when -- those were the amateur contests. They were giving them every week at the Harlem Opera House, which is controlled by the same people, see.

So they put her -- Ella with us. She won it there (with Chick Webb) so they put her with Tiny Bradshaw's band. She was unknown then. And she was singing a song, and I was back in the section, and the thing was a big hit because her (unintelligible) back from the whatchacallit place in Chicago all the time. That's where she got the knack of wanting to sing. So we saw the potentials in Ella. So they -- when she came up, I said, (unintelligible), I said, you going to make it. Said, why? Said, you have all the potential. You

got something. Sure enough, she never forgotten it. And she did. Chick never got a contract. She never had a contract with Chick, because she said, I made my first amateur contest already. Then she made a big show with Jack Bradshaw, and she went back with Chick because Benny Goodman wanted her. She made a record with Benny Goodman, 'Climbing the Stairway to the Stars', and she went right back with Chick and never signed a contract.
